applicable_note: Brief §16 describes idempotence verification AFTER a successful first --commit ("After successful first import: DO NOT execute another --commit. Run a second dry-run only."). No --commit was executed this sprint (decision D), so there is no real first import to check idempotence against yet. What follows is the PURE, in-memory idempotence SIMULATION (planStagingInsert() against fresh fingerprints read from live staging via GET) that this sprint's independent preflight ran in place of that check, plus the real dry-run against live staging that confirms the actual current would-insert count.
method_pure_simulation: planStagingInsert() run twice in-memory: first pass against the 0 existing transport-tier3:v1:* fingerprints currently in live staging, second pass against those same fingerprints plus the 12 fingerprints the first pass would insert.
method_real_dry_run: Real invocation of transport-a2-t3-import.ts (no --commit) against live Supabase, immediately before/after row-count comparison.
future_note: After a real authorized --commit inserts the 12 rows, a genuine second dry-run must be executed and must report: Would insert staging = 0, Already staging = 12. If it reports anything else, that is IDEMPOTENCE_FAILURE (decision F) and must STOP before any further write.
